definitions.explanation: A notebook intended for casual drawing, scribbling, or doodling, often used by children or as a rough sketchbook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{落書|らくが}き{帳|ちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I bought a doodle pad for my child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つい{落書|らくが}き{帳|ちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いて→描く：28436_kaku⟧しまう。
examples.english: I end up drawing in my doodle notebook during meetings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{落書|らくが}き{帳|ちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きて、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしく→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: An old doodle notebook turned up, and I felt nostalgic looking at my childhood drawings.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{落書|らくが}き→落書き：14043_rakugaki⟧ (doodle, scribble, graffiti) and ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook, book). A simple, inexpensive notebook designed for free drawing and scribbling, commonly sold at stationery shops and 100-yen stores in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落書|らくが}き{帳|ちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw in a doodle pad
- {落書|らくが}き{帳|ちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to open a doodle notebook
- ⟦{白紙|はくし}→白紙：13626_hakushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落書|らくが}き{帳|ちょう}: a blank doodle pad

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スケッチブック: sketchbook — slightly more serious art supply, often with thicker paper
- {自由帳|じゆうちょう}: freestyle notebook — similar purpose, the name used in school supply lists
- ⟦{画用紙|がようし}→画用紙：11511_gayoushi⟧: drawing paper — loose sheets rather than a bound notebook
